svg.title: Reading K for n-C₄, n-C₅, n-C₆ at 120 °F and 20 psia
svg.text: Reading K for n-C₄, n-C₅, n-C₆ at 120 °F and 20 psia
High-temperature DePriester chart (nomograph), redrawn from Wankat Eq. 2-30 / Table 2-3
Mark p = 20 psia = 137.9 kPa on the pressure scale (left).
Mark T = 120 °F = 48.9 °C on the temperature scale (right).
Lay a straight edge through the two marks.
Read K where it crosses each scale: n-C₄ 3.49, n-C₅ 1.13, n-C₆ 0.422.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
